description.value: Red Goat Lodge is a wilderness resort perched alongside Eddontenajon Lake in the remote Iskut Valley of Northern BC, 3 km south of Iskut on the Cassiar Highway. The property offers fully furnished cabins with kitchenettes and private baths, motel-style rooms with in-floor boiler heating, and a lakeside campground with power and water hookups — an unusually complete set of options for this stretch of remote highway. Canoe rentals, shuttle services, and floatplane connections to wilderness canoe routes make it a genuine basecamp in the heart of the northwest BC lakes district.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for Red Goat Lodge is fully accessible and provides detailed information about the property. The site confirms cabins, rooms, and a campground on the Cassiar Highway near Iskut, BC, with amenities including on-site laundry, showers, and dining by reservation. No mention of bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, e-bike charging, wash station) appears anywhere on the site, so those required and optional fields are null. Contact details (phone, address, email) are taken from the website, as OSM carries none.
concerns: OSM record contains no address, phone, or email — all contact details sourced from website only.
Website does not mention bike storage, bike handling procedures, or any cycling-specific amenities.
Toll-free number '1-888-REDGOAT' listed alongside local number +1.2502343261; both appear on website but only local number is in standard numeric form.
Email address redgoatlodge@hotmail.com is a consumer-grade inbox, which is common for small remote lodges but worth noting for directory contact purposes.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Red Goat Lodge is a legitimate and active accommodation on the Cassiar Highway — one of BC's key long-distance cycling corridors — with laundry, nearby grocery, and multiple lodging options. However, neither required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) can be confirmed from the website; direct outreach is needed before accreditation.
enrichment_extras.notes: Located on the Cassiar Highway (BC-37) at approximately km 611, this lodge is a strategically important rest stop for northbound or southbound cycle tourers on one of BC's most remote long-distance routes. Dease Lake is 86 km north with additional grocery/fuel. Shuttle services offered by the lodge may be of interest to self-supported tourers.

Laundry.detail: Website (/about.html and /services.html): 'We have showers, laundry and washrooms' in the campground; 'Showers and laundry are accessible.'

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site dining room services available; website states 'Please inquire about bagged lunches and dinner services. Reservations required.' Intended for larger groups but available on-site

Nearby grocery.detail: Website (/services.html): 'Iskut has a small grocery store/post office/gas station' — Iskut is 3 km north of the lodge

wow_evidence: laundry, nearby grocery, and multiple lodging options … one of BC's key long-distance cycling corridors
